name: Bauernhof Lieferthof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Lieferthof in Bad Häring is a family-run inn with an attached farm. The accommodation offers guest rooms in traditional Tiroler style and a dining room with regional cuisine. The dishes are prepared with products from the farm's own production. The location on the edge of Bad Häring allows both hikes in nature and visits to the village center. Guests can tour the farm and experience the work on the farm. The inn is suitable as a starting point for excursions into the surrounding mountain world of the Tiroler Unterland.
